jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer. As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description_text: Every great Spotify experience starts with access. From creating an account to signing in and managing your identity, these foundational moments shape how millions of people connect with the music, podcasts, and content they love. We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our User Platform team and help make these experiences simpler, smarter, and more delightful. You'll work at the intersection of design, product, and engineering, tackling complex challenges across authentication, account management, and emerging AI-powered experiences. This is an opportunity to bring exceptional craft to essential user journeys, explore new technologies, and shape experiences that reach millions of people. We value designers who are curious, hands-on, collaborative, and excited to turn ambitious ideas into beautifully executed products.

jobs.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success. Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it. As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

jobs.description_text: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Within the System Engineering team, lead the technical coordination needed to adapt Lightspeed’s low Earth orbit constellation and associated ground infrastructure for military Ka-band communications supporting the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project - Polar (ESCP-P) and other defence customers. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.description_text: We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage & civil partnership, pregnancy & maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. Role Overview We are looking for a commercially aware Client Operations Specialist (COS), to manage and support UK and European relationships of our existing enterprise clients, whose accounts are primarily based in and managed from the United States. Our clients include globally recognised organisations across sectors such as pharmaceuticals, financial services, legal services, and entertainment. This role requires building and maintaining strong relationships with a range of stakeholders, including internal teams, client contacts, and external vendors and suppliers. From time to time, the role may involve client engagement activities such as attending meetings, meals, or industry events. Working within a small, collaborative team, supporting operational sales processes including vendor registrations, quotation preparation, and order processing. The role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and confidence working with high-value transactions (often involving six-figure sums) whilst being comfortable working within a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Director of Supply Chain
jobs.description_text: The Director of Supply Chain continually works to maximize the value generated by the AHEAD Foundry supply chain by optimizing the flow of goods and information between vendors, AHEAD Foundry, and customers. They strengthen and expand vendor relationships, maintain efficient inventory levels, and work closely with sales to develop strong forecasting disciplines. They are keenly aware of market trends in computer server components and work closely with vendors on supply-side planning. They work to reduce logistics and warehousing costs while developing accurate, vital metrics with which to measure success and ongoing progress. They oversee all purchasing, warehousing, and logistics functions, along with key vendor relationships, and lead a team of Buyers with varying degrees of responsibility and specialties

jobs.title: Director, Financial Solutions
jobs.description_text: AHEAD is seeking a Director, Financial Solutions to join our Financial Solutions Group (FSG). This role supports a geographic territory aligned with sales and partners closely with sales leadership, clients, accounts receivable, manufacturers, and internal finance teams. The Director, Financial Solutions helps AHEAD structure strategic financing solutions, improve cash outcomes, support complex transactions, and enable financial selling across the business. The ideal candidate combines strong financial-selling experience with commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Director, Security Delivery
jobs.description_text: The Director for Security Delivery is responsible for managing the go-to-market, practice resources and overall strategy in alignment with other senior leaders within AHEAD’s Security practice. This position will be responsible for building and maintaining business, executive and operational relationships with critical vendors. They will manage and support their direct reports (client services team) in order to develop and maintain a high performing team. The Director will work in partnership with the Security Leaders and Sales teams to ensure Practice deliverables to customers are complete, consistent, high quality, on time and deliver valued outcomes. They work in partnership with the team to ensure the Practice is executing and delivering on our financial commitments of margin and revenue recognition to the business. In addition to managing and delivering client engagements, you will work in partnership with multiple leaders across AHEAD’s geographies to help support development of sales artifacts, proposals, and collateral for existing and prospective clients.

jobs.title: Engineer - Salesforce
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Engineer to design, develop, and implement customized solutions within the Salesforce platform. In this role, you will contribute to the evolution of our Salesforce ecosystem by developing scalable solutions across Sales, CPQ, Billing, and enterprise integrations. You’ll work closely with architects, administrators and business stakeholders to deliver high-impact features and enhancements that support our fast-growing organization.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description_text: The Executive Assistant serves as a trusted and highly proactive partner to one or more C-level executives at AHEAD. By protecting executive time, anticipating needs, organizing competing priorities, and driving follow-through, this role creates the leverage needed to focus on the highest-value work. A central part of the role is making day-to-day executive work easier by knowing what is needed before it is requested, removing friction, and creating a smooth, well-organized experience around the work. The ideal candidate brings exceptional judgment, discretion, organization, and communication skills. They are comfortable operating with limited direction, quickly distinguish what is urgent from what is important, and represent executive leadership and AHEAD with professionalism and polish in every interaction.

jobs.title: Network - Specialist Solutions Engineer
jobs.description_text: AHEAD’s Specialist Solutions Engineers are the technical experts that collaborate with our AHEAD account teams to help identify, qualify, and build solutions that support our customer’s Digital Business transformation. The AHEAD Network Specialist Solutions Engineer (SSE) will be focused on Networking technologies. A core tenet and base requirement for this position is mastery of Cisco Route/Switch and/or Datacenter technologies. Outside of this core tenet, our expectation is to attract, recruit and attain resources who have a desire to focus not only on traditional on-premises Cisco solutions, but also to be looking to career, technology and skill advancement by being actively willing to demonstrate skills and ability to learn new technologies including multiple SDN solutions, network security, load balancing, edge / acceleration, and cloud technologies. Understanding that the impetus and impact of Cloud computing is real and should be incorporated into solutions is key. Experience or eagerness to learn about and with network and system / access design with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure or other cloud services is a key requirement. The SSE is considered a subject matter expert in these areas with responsibility for selling and designing complex solutions. The SSE is also considered an organizational thought leader for their specialty area.

Your responsibilities include defining installation and integration steps, creating cable maps and routing plans, building labeling standards, and producing complete rack design documentation that supports accurate builds, labor estimation, and pre-sales assessments. You will collaborate with internal teams and clients and may travel on-site to support rack delivery and installation.

Our HPC Compute Engineers are a valued member of the Managed Services Infrastructure Practice responsible for Tier 3 incident management, service request management and change management infrastructure support for all Managed Services customers. The successful candidate will own critical components of the compute environment—from Linux hosts, GPUs, HPC clusters, and physical hardware through schedulers, containers, monitoring, automation, and version maintenance. The engineer will work closely with our internal infrastructure teams, vendors, and customers to deliver reliable, secure, and efficient AI compute services.

Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.

jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description_text: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. You will help own them, and the tooling around them, so that training, evaluation and production all speak exactly the same language. You will work across the entire stack, spanning pretraining, post-training and deployment, and your decisions will reach every model we ship. What you will do Design, build and maintain core libraries for tokenization and model interfaces. Evolve our formats and tokenizers as models and use cases change. Turn research needs into robust, shared tooling. What we're looking for Strong software engineering background, with excellent Python. Excellent understanding of tokenizers: BPE and other tokenization algorithms, special tokens, chat templates, and tokenizer training; ideally hands-on experience with libraries such as tiktoken or Hugging Face tokenizers. Experience building production-grade libraries used by many people. A taste for correctness and attention to detail. Good knowledge of how LLMs are trained and served. Clear communication, low ego, and a collaborative mindset. Nice to have Open-source maintenance experience. Experience with inference engines. Location and remote This role is primarily based at one of our European offices (Paris and London). We will prioritize candidates who either reside there or are open to relocating. jobs.description_text: The team Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all. We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write. European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it. The Role Agents don't run in browsers. We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description_text: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME) Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk Vakantiegeld 8% CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00 Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team Inform

jobs.title: Data Officer
jobs.description_text: Als Data Officer speel je een belangrijke rol in het ondersteunen van het productontwikkelingsproces door technische gegevens over grondstoffen en verpakkingscomponenten te verzamelen en in te voeren in het Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) en Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systeem van het bedrijf. De functie omvat regelmatige communicatie met leveranciers om informatie op te vragen, de volledigheid van gegevens te controleren en ervoor te zorgen dat alle artikelgegevens accuraat en up-to-date zijn. Deze functie is ideaal voor iemand met veel oog voor detail en interesse in cosmetica, gegevensbeheer of productontwikkeling. Ons Data team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Regulatory Affairs. De afdeling bestaat uit twee Regulatory Affairs Specialisten, vier Regulatory Affairs Officers. en twee Data Officers. In deze functie rapporteer je aan de Manager Regulatory Affairs. MISSION Het bij leveranciers opvragen en verzamelen van technische gegevens, specificaties en documentatie voor grondstoffen en verpakkingen. De door leveranciers ingediende documenten controleren op volledigheid en juistheid (bijv. INCI-lijsten, veiligheidsinformatiebladen, specificaties, certificaten, enz. Nauwkeurig invoeren en bijwerken van materiaal- en verpakkingsgegevens in het PLM- en ERP-systeem. Bijhouden van openstaande leveranciersinformatie en indien nodig opvolgen. Ondersteunen van interne teams (Innovation & Research, Regulatory Affairs en Purchase) met nauwkeurige gegevensbeschikbaarheid

jobs.title: Teamleider Behandel- en Expertisecentrum Zodiak | 32-36 uur | Purmerend
jobs.description_text: Bouw mee aan de toekomst van de specialistische behandelzorg Binnen het Behandel- en Expertisecentrum Zodiak van Prinsenstichting zetten we de volgende stap in de ontwikkeling van onze behandeldienst. De basis staat stevig en daardoor ontstaat ruimte voor verdere innovatie en ontwikkeling. Daarom breiden we ons leiderschapsteam uit met een derde Teamleider. Voor deze nieuwe positie zoeken wij een verbindende en ondernemende leidinggevende die richting geeft aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze individuele en ambulante behandeling. Een professional die kansen ziet, mensen in beweging krijgt en samen met behandelaren bouwt aan toekomstbestendige zorg. Wat ga je doen? Als Teamleider van het Behandel- en Expertisecentrum Zodiak geef je leiding aan een aantal behandeldisciplines en professionals binnen onze behandeldienst. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van medewerkers en draagt tegelijkertijd actief bij aan de doorontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. De focus van deze functie ligt op het verder vormgeven van onze ambulante en individuele behandelzorg. Je onderzoekt samen met behandelaren hoe we onze expertise nog beter toegankelijk kunnen maken voor cliënten, verwanten en verwijzers. Daarbij werk je aan kwaliteit, samenwerking, doelmatigheid en innovatie. Je beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen operationele vraagstukken en strategische ontwikkelingen en weet professionals mee te nemen in verandering. jobs.title: Product Owner Werkplek & Support
jobs.description_text: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat ruim 3.300 collega’s iedere dag goed hun werk kunnen doen? Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. Wie ben jij Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen. Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten. Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn. jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.description_text: Over Ockto Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen. Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing). Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten. Met meer dan 100 aangesloten organisaties bouwen we dagelijks verder aan een toekomst waarin betrouwbare data de basis vormt voor slimme, efficiënte en volledig digitale dienstverlening. De rol We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen.
